name: Debito
source:
Bears a contract with #9 of the Arcana - The Hermit, his ability is to make himself invisible with the Arcana Mark on his foot, near his ankle. Bipolar captain of the Coins who hates to be tied and loves to flirt, including with Felicitá. He has a foul mouth, but he’s actually a good big brother figure. [spoiler]He covered his right eye with an eyepatch to cover his artificial eye that is used to control his Arcana power, made by Jolly.[/spoiler] Debito calls Felicitá "Bambina" - which means "little girl" in Italian. 

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/La_storia_della_Arcana_Famiglia#Characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
